job_description.summary: Cisco is hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. The role focuses on delivering scalable cloud applications, improving products and services, designing distributed systems, and developing features through the software lifecycle. Engineers work independently with guidance, may lead small-to-medium features from technical design through completion, and are expected to code, debug, test, troubleshoot, contribute to software quality, collaborate with others, and use AI-assisted development workflows responsibly.
responsibilities: Use software-engineering best practices and knowledge of business or technical issues to improve products and services.
Work independently with guidance from a leader and determine an appropriate approach to assigned work.
Potentially lead small-to-medium features from technical design through completion.
Maintain knowledge of software-development lifecycle practices and agile engineering; coach others when needed.
Advocate for product features that address customer needs.
Track metrics related to product adoption and success.
Perform coding, debugging, testing, and troubleshooting throughout development with minimal supervision.
Use AI-assisted development tools to improve development efficiency and automate testing, while validating generated output responsibly.
basic_qualifications: Bachelor's degree with 0 to 2 years of experience, or a Master's degree with 0 years of experience, in Computer Science or a related field.
Strong grasp of data structures and algorithms.
Proficiency in at least one of C/C++, Java, Python, or Golang.
Ability to design distributed systems and reason about application scalability and cloud environments.
Ability to use AI coding assistants such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate development and automate testing.
preferred_qualifications: Proven ability to resolve complex technical problems.
